description: Known ITL workflow defects. Read on demand from workflow-incidents.md while diagnosing; update-workflow matches fixed keys against project handoff reports. Maintained by ITL source developers; a fix moves its entry to fixed in the same commit.

entries.symptom: After a failed on-demand MCP start the client and the per-infobase guard keep holding the infobase; the helper waits in waiting-for-base.
entries.workaround: None needed after the fix. Previously: call close_1c_session before helper actions.

entries.symptom: After a lost backend connection or an infobase reload the facade lease keeps holding the infobase; cleanup refuses with LAUNCH_PROOF_REQUIRED or RECOVERY_LEASE_CHANGED and check-dev-branch fails.
entries.workaround: None needed after the fix. A recurrence on facade 0.4.30 or later is a new incident.

entries.symptom: After a successful execute_code the ROCTUP client keeps the infobase and check-dev-branch stalls in Designer until DESIGNER_STALL_TIMEOUT.
entries.workaround: None needed after the fix; do not call close_1c_session before every helper action. DESIGNER_INFOBASE_RELEASE_BLOCKED remains a retryable execution conflict.

entries.symptom: Right after TestClient shutdown its port still counts as busy (TIME_WAIT, ESTABLISHED or CLOSE_WAIT) and the next start fails.
entries.workaround: None needed after the fix; extra port waits added to features are unnecessary.

entries.symptom: A Vanessa code step executed through the clipboard extension swallows the exception and reports success.
entries.workaround: None needed after the fix; trace files for clipboard steps are unnecessary.
entries.regression: OneScript probes and native build recorded in commit 1e99c70c

entries.symptom: After refresh or update-workflow a facade process started earlier by the client keeps running the old version; ITL does not detect it.
entries.workaround: Reconnect the MCP server or start one new chat (references/mcp.md).

entries.symptom: After update-dev-branch-base the service TESTMANAGER exits about 1 s after start; the port wait still runs its full timeout.
entries.workaround: Repeat the same command once; do not add blind retries. The root cause is not established.

entries.symptom: execute_feature_step reports success for a step that raises an exception.
entries.workaround: Treat execute_feature_step as diagnostic only; prove the result with run_scenario or a full check.

entries.symptom: Closing a workflow-owned Enterprise client (TestClient, TESTMANAGER, ROCTUP) aborts a running file-infobase scheduled job; check-dev-branch then reports event-log debt.
entries.workaround: Run acknowledge-event-log-errors for the reviewed entries (references/verification-result.md).

entries.symptom: While the Windows session is locked a UI step cannot find the VAExtension form and the run is classified as product-assertion.
entries.workaround: Unlock the Windows session and repeat the same command; do not treat the failure as a product defect.

entries.symptom: A hidden TestClient form takes the foreground during a run; user keystrokes reach the 1C client.
entries.workaround: Avoid typing during a Vanessa UI run; repeat the run when a stray input is visible in the journal.

codes: chore: reset branch for next change
entries.symptom: A branch reset creates a single-parent commit, so the next refresh merges against an old merge base and reports false conflicts.
entries.workaround: Resolve each refresh conflict against current master content; do not keep the branch side for files already in master.

entries.symptom: check-dev-branch is killed by the runner watchdog after tests pass, while assessment and the user report run without a heartbeat.
entries.workaround: Set ITL_RUNNER_STATUS_STALE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=300 and repeat the same command.

entries.symptom: Remote code/graph MCP answers describe the indexed master snapshot, not the current worktree.
entries.workaround: Confirm code claims by reading src/cf; decide whether a fix is in master with git log master.

entries.symptom: A failed execute_form_actions, a modal window or get_form_element_data for a missing element ends TestClient; the next call starts a fresh client.
entries.workaround: Restore the UI state with one self-contained scenario (open, input, assert).

entries.symptom: A stateful Vanessa UI call runs on a replaced, empty TestClient without a warning; input steps report success.
entries.workaround: Compare _meta.itlTestClient.pid between calls; restore the state with one self-contained scenario.

codes: значение не является значением объектного типа
entries.symptom: A run_scenario result whose failed step or product text contains a generic platform phrase is replaced by a runtime/editor failure.
entries.workaround: Read the scenario result in the run report or reproduce through the normal check before blaming the runtime.

entries.symptom: One fixed Vanessa budget covers the whole selected TESTMANAGER run; long suites end by timeout without test failures.
entries.workaround: Raise VANESSA_TEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS in .dev.env; the runner already extends to the phase budget, so do not raise ITL_RUNNER_CHECK_DEV_BRANCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.

entries.symptom: The Vanessa service TESTMANAGER infobase sometimes fails to start with an invalid configuration signature; no automatic retry exists.
entries.workaround: Repeat the same command; the service infobase is per worktree, so this is not a race with another branch.
